gold_findings.summary: Runner completion is incorrectly treated as accepted completion despite a failed audit.
gold_findings.required_repair: Separate runner and audit states and withhold accepted completion until a passing audit and audit-completion marker exist.

gold_findings.summary: Paper-table eligibility is claimed although the audit failed and the report explicitly sets it false.
